_note: Feed for transmissions.html (the Channel Terminal). Add a new update by putting an object at the TOP of `entries` — newest first, the page does not sort for you. Nothing else needs changing: channels, counts and the readout all derive from this file. See `_template` below for every supported field. No API keys, no build step, no third-party service.

_template.id: next number, zero-padded to 3 — this is the log number shown on the left
_template.channel: one of the channel ids below: x | instagram | tiktok | youtube | spotify | filed
_template.time: HH:MM, 24h. Optional; omit for filed pieces that have no clock time
_template.title: short — this is the line that reads in the row
_template.body: the full text. Shown when the row is opened
_template.mediaAlt: required whenever media is set — describes the image for screen readers
_template.video: optional true — marks it as a clip and shows the play glyph
_template.href: optional external URL — the post on the platform
_template.internal: optional internal page, e.g. transmissions/001.html. Wins over href if both are set

_channelsNote: Every channel listed here gets a tab, whether or not it has entries. That is deliberate — an empty frequency reads as 'NO SIGNAL ON THIS FREQUENCY', which is true, on-concept, and tells a visitor which platforms exist. Set "hideEmptyChannels": true at the top level if you would rather only show channels that have something in them. Remove a platform from this list entirely if you are not on it.
_seedNote: The four entries marked "seed": true below are true statements about the project, written so the page has something real on it at launch. Edit them into your own voice or delete them — they are not load-bearing. Transmission 001 at the bottom is genuine and links to its existing page; keep that one.

entries.title: The download link now comes to you
entries.body: Every purchase now emails the buyer their download link the moment the payment clears. Until today the confirmation page was the only way back to the files, and a Stripe receipt shows the purchase rather than that page — so a tab closed on a phone took the whole entitlement with it. The email opens the same seventy-two hour window the page does, not a longer one. Orders are recorded now as well, which they were not before, so a buyer who runs past the window can be looked up instead of lost.

entries.title: Rise Up is open
entries.body: The Digital Edition is available. Twenty-eight tracks, delivered twice — as MP3s to listen to and as the WAV masters to keep — and both download from the confirmation page the moment the payment clears. Nothing waits on a person. The Deluxe and Artifact editions stay filed: they are physical objects, and they go out when they exist rather than when they are announced.
entries.mediaAlt: Rise Up album cover — two hooded figures rising out of a cracked graveyard beneath a glowing spinal column and a sigil-marked moon.

entries.title: May 26th completes the library
entries.body: The last missing sample is in. Twenty-eight tracks, twenty-eight covers, twenty-eight pieces of moving artwork, twenty-eight samples — the Rise Up library is closed. May 26th's artwork has never been seen moving, because the video only rolls while the audio is audible, and until now there was no audio.
entries.mediaAlt: May 26th cover art — a figure with a glowing spinal column beneath a planet, flanked by DNA helices and two hooded Messengers.

entries.title: Brutus, replaced
entries.body: New cover and new moving artwork for Brutus. The throne, the skull, the severed marble head at its feet. Some betrayals do not need a bridge or a hook — just the moment right before the knife.
entries.mediaAlt: Brutus cover art — a skull-faced figure seated on a throne in a ruined city, a marble bust toppled at its feet.

entries.title: Thirty-three and seven
entries.body: Thirty-three vertebrae. Seven nodes. One signal moving through the whole structure. Everything here is built on that count — it is not decoration, it is the architecture.
entries.mediaAlt: Spine Glow cover art — an illuminated spinal column rendered as a signal receiver.

entries.title: Source Unknown
entries.body: Some signals arrive before the words that explain them. This one came first — masked, hooded, standing at the edge between fog and geometry. What it means depends on how closely you are listening.
entries.mediaAlt: Transmission 001 — a masked Messenger of Kundalini Spines against a blueprint-and-spine backdrop.
